newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai machinery exports up 53 pct in 1997 H1.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai machinery exports up 53 pct in 1997 H1.

text.p: Shanghai's machinery exports rose a year-on-year 53.1 percent to $2.138 billion in the first half of 1997, the Business News said on Friday.

Machinery processing trade -- under which raw materials are imported duty free and the final product exported -- totalled $1.587 billion in the first six months of the year, accounting for 74.2 of total machinery exports, the newspaper said.
Machinery exports to North America grew 77 percent to $505 million in the first half of the year compared with the same 1996 period, it said.
Foreign-funded companies were the main exporters, selling machinery products worth $1.44 billion, accounting for 67.3 percent of total machinery export value, it added.
